The Magic Laboratory

His, the mage who might answer questions about the artifact, has shut himself in his laboratory and has not visited the city for a long time. His laboratory is nearby; try paying him a visit.

Objectives

Find the laboratory entrance

Switch off the trap

Kill the guard tigers

Infiltrate the laboratory
